name: Kitsune medium kick
notes: Head-high straight kick, clip 35 frames, hit 11-25 (foot at 107 cm = 214 units, hitbox y 150-210). Deviation from C8 7/3/14: startup +3, active +12, recovery -4. A 15-frame active window is the clip's truth; designer may want a shorter active via a re-trim. Standing mid (not low). The hakama tube around the leg is not added to the hurtbox beyond the leg box. Hurtbox: the E5 standing body 90x360 for the whole move; the wide sleeves are NOT added (they are cloth, not body); only the bare striking limb gets an extra hurtbox while it is extended. Hitstun, blockstun and pushback are placeholders on the Ryo fixture scale (not in rules.md); damage is the C8 number (no Kitsune table exists).
